A menacing three-meter-tall BIPEDAL urban suppression combat walker, exactly TWO massive reverse-jointed hydraulic legs with broad heavy armored feet planted firmly apart. Broad squat armored torso, thick sloped front armor, exposed piston knees and hip joints, one small recessed red optical sensor instead of a human face. A thick short autocannon physically integrated into the RIGHT side of the torso on a robust joint, a powerful articulated gripping claw on the LEFT. Visible side maintenance hatch, heavy cables and vents. Dark gunmetal grey armor with worn ochre industrial warning stripes. Brutal industrial construction machinery silhouette, substantial weight and combat power, no cockpit or pilot, no heroic humanoid proportions. Entire body and both feet visible, three-quarter full-body view from slightly below, soft frontal studio lighting, transparent background.
